_comment: ZeroTrustAuditor configuration file. Copy and customize per engagement.
_correlationNote: scope=host requires both findings to touch a common host (a real attack chain). scope=domain only requires both conditions to exist somewhere in the domain and is tagged as such on the finding, because it is a weaker signal.

rules.name: SMB relay + local admin spread
rules.rationale: Unsigned SMB enables NTLM relay; shared local admin means one relay = many hosts compromised.

rules.name: NTLMv1 + local admin spread
rules.rationale: NTLMv1 hashes crack quickly; combined with admin overlap enables mass lateral movement.

rules.name: Unconstrained delegation + Kerberoasting
rules.rationale: Cracking the Kerberoastable SPN yields a ticket that can be presented to the unconstrained host. Both are domain-scoped objects, so this is an AND of two domain-wide facts rather than host co-location.

rules.name: DCSync rights + stale account
rules.rationale: Stale accounts are unlikely to have MFA or active monitoring; DCSync right means instant domain takeover.

rules.name: Unencrypted WinRM + local admin spread
rules.rationale: Plaintext WinRM exposes credentials in transit; admin overlap multiplies blast radius.

rules.name: RDP NLA disabled + writable SMB share
rules.rationale: Pre-auth RDP exposure combined with writable share creates both remote exec and persistence vectors. checkB previously read OPEN_SMB_SHARE, a name no check ever emits, so this rule could never match.
